description: Source code for the DU PUCCH resource management in a 5G NR network, handling resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration for PUCCH channels, including SR and CSI resources, within a gNB's DU component.

classes.name: du_pucch_resource_manager
classes.description: Manages PUCCH resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration for UEs in a 5G NR DU context.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds and initializes resources for a new cell based on its configuration.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell and its associated resources from management.

methods.name: alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates PUCCH resources for a new UE, including SR and CSI resources, updating configurations accordingly.

methods.name: dealloc_resources
methods.description: Releases PUCCH resources assigned to a UE, returning them to the free pool.

methods.name: get_compatible_csi_cfg
methods.description: Finds a compatible CSI resource configuration that fits within payload limits and does not collide with SR resources.

methods.name: offset_exceeds_limit
methods.description: Checks if a given offset exceeds the maximum number of grants per slot.

methods.name: compute_periodic_uci_slot_offsets
methods.description: Computes the set of slot offsets for SR and CSI resources based on their periodicities.

methods.name: sr_csi_offsets_collide
methods.description: Determines if SR and CSI resource offsets collide in time, using CRT logic.

methods.name: update_serv_cell_cfg
methods.description: Updates the serving cell configuration with allocated PUCCH resources, offsets, and payload limits.

methods.name: disable_pucch_cfg
methods.description: Disables PUCCH configuration for a cell, clearing related settings.
